question: What will the first reported revenues after September 2026 be for the following companies? (AMD)

calls.reasoning: AMD guided Q3 2026 revenue ~$13.0B ±$0.3B; consensus ~$13.06B (Bernstein $13.1B). Reference class: AMD's last ~8 quarters, all beat guidance midpoint by ~1.6–7% (verified Q1'26 9.8→10.253, Q2'26 11.2→11.536). Applying a ~3.3% median beat gives ~13.43B. Downside: server CPU supply tightness capping upside, AI-trade softness; upside: Instinct ramp (Meta/OpenAI). No Polymarket/Kalshi/Manifold market found. Report due Nov 3, not yet released.

- AMD Q2 2026 (reported early Aug 2026): revenue $11.536B, +50% YoY; Data Center $6.718B (+107% YoY), Client $3.062B, Gaming $0.779B (-31%), Embedded $0.977B (AMD IR press release).
- Q3 2026 guidance (Aug 2026): ~$13.0B ± $0.3B, ~+41% YoY, ~+13% QoQ, non-GAAP GM ~56% (AMD IR / SEC 8-K).
- Consensus Q3 revenue ~$13.06B (MarketBeat, Oct 2026); Bernstein $13.1B (TipRanks, Oct 2026); Hudson Labs preview (Oct 7, 2026) consensus $13,058M.
- Guide-vs-actual history: Q2'26 guide 11.2 → 11.536 (+3.0%); Q1'26 guide 9.8 → 10.253 (+4.6%) (SEC 8-Ks). Earlier quarters from memory: Q4'25 9.6 → 10.27 (+7%, incl. ~$390M one-off MI308 China); Q3'25 8.7 → 9.246 (+6%); Q2'25 7.4 → 7.685 (+4%); Q1'25 7.1 → 7.438 (+5%); Q4'24 7.5 → 7.658 (+2%); Q3'24 6.7 → 6.819 (+2%). Every quarter in this window landed above the guidance midpoint; range of beats ~+1.6% to +7%.
- Risks noted: server CPU supply chain tight (Hudson Labs); customer concentration (Meta, OpenAI, Anthropic); press on 'cracks in AI trade' ahead of earnings (cryptobriefing, Oct 2026).
- Status quo: revenue lands within or just above the guided range.
- Resolution: resolves off the headline total revenue in AMD's Q3 FY2026 earnings release / 8-K (scheduled Nov 3, 2026 after close), not off later 10-Q revisions.
- Event window: quarter ended ~Sep 26, 2026; release Nov 3, 2026. As of Oct 29, 2026 the quarter is complete and the release is pending.
- Searched for: preannouncements or guidance changes (none found); prediction markets on Polymarket/Kalshi/Manifold (none found); China MI308 inclusion in guidance (no mention in the release).

calls.reconciliation: All three runs share the same evidence (guide $13.0B±0.3B, consensus ~$13.06-13.12B, 8/8 beats of 1.8-7.0%). The only factual question was whether the guidance figures runs 1/2 recalled from memory were accurate; they match run 3's press-release-sourced list and my own recall, so I accepted the history. The remaining dispute is judgment over beat size (3.0-3.5%); with the last two beats smaller and supply limits flagged, I took ~3.3%. I carry forward the shared reference class and a dispersion of about $640M, consistent with run 3's. No escape mass: a move outside $12.0B-$14.2B would need a >9% beat or >7.7% miss, which hasn't happened in the last 8 quarters.
